name: Leg curl
notes: Seated or lying machine hamstring curl.

guide.setup: Align the knee joint with the machine pivot and place the pad securely above the ankles.
guide.execution: Curl the pad through a controlled range, squeeze briefly, then return slowly until the knees are nearly straight.
guide.cues: Keep the hips pinned. Start each rep with the hamstrings. Control the return.
guide.mistakes: Lifting the hips; snapping knees straight; using momentum; setting the pad too low on the calves.
